name: earmark-codex
description: Shared issue board for Codex and other coding agents through the earmark CLI: join a role, claim the next issue, hand off to review, triage the backlog. SQLite, stdlib Python, no MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Local issue board shared by a team of coding agents
interface.longDescription: Join the project board as a worker, reviewer or pm, claim the next issue with an atomic lease, post progress, hand off to review and read only new comments, all through the earmark CLI over one local SQLite file.
defaultPrompt: Use /earmark join worker to pick up the next issue on the board.
Use /earmark review to work the review queue.
